description: Skyline native tool shadowing for Grok: PreToolUse redirects read_file / search_replace / run_terminal_command / grep / list_dir to the equivalent skyline_* MCP tools (when daemon up). Fails open.

hooks.command: PLUGIN_ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || [ ! -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skyline-enforce.sh" ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'; exit 0; fi; sh "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skyline-enforce.sh" bash

PLUGIN_ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || [ ! -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skyline-enforce.sh" ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'; exit 0; fi; sh "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skyline-enforce.sh" read

PLUGIN_ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || [ ! -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skyline-enforce.sh" ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'; exit 0; fi; sh "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skyline-enforce.sh" grep
